title: Merge receipt
summary: The observer atomically records the current PR branch, target, head and merge SHA with landing stamps before notifying the worker. Worker closeout enriches that receipt with results and verification; later landings retain earlier identities. A no-content closeout uses the newest completed receipt after verifying its merge on the fetched target, even when a later unarmed PR has no observation. A newer own merge still requires its own observation instead of an older receipt. Missing identity refuses with merge_recorded_landing_missing and operator recovery. Local merges resolve the first carrying merge or fast-forward candidate.
